title: Playboy Magazine June 1992 Playmate of the Year Ralph Nader Bob Costas
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal storage and handling wear; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1992 - Playmate of the Year issue. Cover price $4.95.

Features:
- Playmate of the Year
- Playboy Interviews Ralph Nader
- Plus Bob Costas, Patrick Swayze, and how to talk to your lover

NOTE ON THE PHOTOS: this issue is at TOP LEFT in the group photo and SECOND FROM TOP in the stack.
